parameters.content:
## Phase 1 - Data Ingestion & Preparation
Captures the submitted form, extracts PDF resume text, fetches the exact job requirements from Google Sheets, and unifies the data payload for the AI.

## Phase 2 - Autonomous AI Evaluation
Gemini evaluates the extracted resume against the job requirements, outputs a structured JSON decision (High/Medium/Low), and routes the workflow via the Switch node.

## Phase 3 - High-Tier (Autonomous Scheduling)
Fast-tracks top matches. Sends an assessment link, calculates 
the next available 9-to-5 calendar slot, books a Google Meet 
Interview, and sends an executive summary to the HR Manager.

## Phase 4: Medium-Tier (Further Assessment)
Invites partial-match candidates to complete a standardised skills assessment, 
holding them in the pipeline for further human recruiter review.

## Phase 5 - Low-Tier (Automated Rejection)
Instantly closes the loop by sending a polite, customised rejection email 
to the applicant using the specific reasoning generated by the AI agent.
